findings.text: The first case passes base_revision into _suite_gate_prompt_body itself (lines 107-108) and then asserts the brief contains that same base_revision, so the two sides move together; nothing exercises the dispatch call site at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3007 that reads worktree.get("base_sha"). If that key were blanked or renamed, the brief would name no revision and this case would stay green.

_tree_head shells its own git rev-parse HEAD instead of extending the repository's one shared commit resolver, _resolve_commit at reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:246, which reckon/crew/merge.py:200 documents as the shared resolver and calls with "HEAD" for exactly this query.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_brief_names_the_armed_suite_command.py:133 compares the brief against the base_revision the test itself passed at line 108, so the dispatch call-site wiring at dispatch.py:3007 is unguarded; the second case at line 207 does assert independently against hardcoded commands.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_brief_names_the_armed_suite_command.py ran 2 passed at head and 2 failed at base 067c8035e4, and the added failure set derived from arms/baseline.log and arms/after.log is empty (40 base vs 38 after).
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/resumption.py:1536 follows the surrounding deferred-import and docstring idiom and introduces no forbidden name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1542 states the base revision and the after-arm rule in the brief, and reckon/crew/resumption.py:1536 resolves the declaration at both revisions for the resume advice.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/resumption.py:1522 re-implements the shared commit resolver reckon/crew/recovery_review_subject.py:246 rather than extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (reckon/crew/dispatch.py, reckon/crew/resumption.py, the new test, docs/evidence/fragments/...) lies inside the declared write paths, and recovery_repair_dispatch.py was deliberately left unchanged.
